field_changes.old:
New! Premium users with access to the AI coach can now save meal suggestions as a repeatable meal that can be easily logged again and again. Great feature if you need simple dinner ideas ... and a shortcut for logging them.

Fixed: Accessing GLP-1 support through the more menu was taking some users back to the home screen instead of medication logging. Now all GLP-1 users can log meds quickly without a detour. (Feature is currently available in the U.S. only.)
field_changes.new:
Added: GLP-1 support features are now available in both the US and Canada. This includes new Generic Semaglutide medication logging.

Fixed: The fasting timer would slow down or stall when you left the app mid-fast.
Now it keeps ticking, even in the background.

*Our bug fixing efforts are guided by a simple mantra: See no Weevil, Hear no Weevil, Speak no Weevil.

*For all the latest fixes, update to the latest app version
